name: vortex-game-kit
description: Shared standard, protocol and conformance tests for connecting games to Vortex Studio stories and editors.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release: git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet || (echo 'Commit your changes first.' && exit 1); npm run check && git push && git tag v$npm_package_version && git push origin v$npm_package_version
